reviews.comment:
El Automóvil Club Argentino es un clásico, nunca defrauda. Todo lo relacionado al mundo del motor lo tienen muy estudiado y eligen y forman a los mejores empleados, con lo cual, es difícil no tener una excelente experiencia cuando uno se acerca con alguna necesidad. Están muy distribuidos a nivel nacional, lo cual también es un importante esfuerzo que hay que reconocerles. Para mí son un número fijo.

(Translated by Google)
The Argentine Automobile Club is a classic; it never disappoints. They have everything related to the automotive world thoroughly researched and they select and train the best employees, so it's hard not to have an excellent experience when you approach them with a need. They have a wide distribution throughout the country, which is also a significant effort that deserves recognition. For me, they're a sure thing.

Bien ... Pero como paso el domingo había cola de autos hasta la Av.
Uno supuso que había demasiada demanda, pero NO ... era que solo había DOS playeros y se ponían conversar con los clientes como si no hubiese nadie de tras en la espera.
Una pena que no estén supervisados

(Translated by Google)
Well... But as happened on Sunday, there was a line of cars stretching all the way to the avenue. One assumed there was too much demand, but NO... it was just that there were only TWO attendants and they were chatting with customers as if there were no one else waiting behind them.
It's a shame they aren't supervised.
